content.title: The Racovian Catechism (1605; English translation 1818)
content.author: Polish Brethren (Socinians): Valentin Smalcius, Hieronim Moskorzowski and Johannes Völkel, completing work begun under Faustus Socinus · translated by Thomas Rees (London: Longman, 1818)
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
content.note: The catechism of the Polish Brethren, first printed in Polish in 1605; Rees translated the revised Latin text of 1680. The classic statement of the case against satisfaction: God forgives freely, so a debt that has been paid has not been forgiven. Cited for the Socinian objections in their own terms, never as teaching. Public domain (published 1818).
